title: Bridge Candidate Register: typed map segment for From Prephysical Hypotheses to Physical Models
author: LLM Director D (Claude, Anthropic) at the direction of Kirtus Justus
reading_rule: Nodes are model classes. Edges are typed. Nothing in this file asserts a physical derivation or a selected ontology; it records checked relations, postulates that would have to be supplied, obstructions, discriminators and untested proposals so that the search space is explicit.

edge_types.exact_correspondence: proved relation within or between mathematical models, with a locator
edge_types.postulate: an axiom that would have to be supplied by a candidate for the edge to exist
edge_types.obstruction: a checked nonselection, ambiguity or impossibility within a stated class
edge_types.discriminator: an observable quantity whose value separates classes; carries its calibration obligations
edge_types.untested_transfer: a proposed relation with no warrant beyond its proposal

nodes.PRE-REL: finite relational structures (finite positive-arity signature, homomorphic equivalence, cores) [baseline, Collections Overview §Relational]
nodes.PRE-SIG: signed-sector signal proposal (exploratory; no construction or observation law) [baseline program figure]
nodes.PRE-CAUSAL: bare causal/incidence graph (order, compatibility, local counting) [Toy packet comparator]
nodes.PRE-CTX: unrestricted contextual tables incl. TO-0 (local, quantum and PR-type tables) [withdrawn as ontology; negative control]
nodes.GPT-CLASSICAL: classical probabilistic theory (simplex state space, deterministic pure states)
nodes.QT: complex quantum theory (C*-algebraic / Hilbert space, Born rule, tensor products)
nodes.GPT-BEYOND: generalized probabilistic theories beyond QT (PR boxes, pentagon state, third-order interference)
nodes.CM-SYMP: classical Hamiltonian mechanics on a symplectic manifold (incl. integrable systems with monodromy)
nodes.CM-STOCH: classical stochastic dynamics induced by full dephasing (T_ji = |U_ji|^2) [FAR-1 demonstration]
nodes.GEOM-EPS: Ehlers–Pirani–Schild: events, light rays, free fall -> conformal + projective -> Weyl -> (extra axiom) Lorentzian metric
nodes.FAR-1: finite amplitude-record toy universe [stipulated; negative control; all quantum structure imported]
nodes.WILSON: Wilson–Dirac interval relative-entropy results [baseline; fixed-mass finite part proved; cross-boundary path S(mu) dependency open]

edges.statement: Geometric quantization: prequantum line bundle with connection whose curvature is the symplectic form; trivial holonomy on Lagrangian tori is the Bohr–Sommerfeld condition; integrality 2j in Z for the sphere.
edges.locator: Kostant–Souriau; checked here only through the spin-j coherent-state phase jΩ (verify_transport_bridges.py B)

edges.statement: Classical Hamiltonian monodromy of a focus-focus singularity equals the quantum monodromy of the joint spectrum lattice.
edges.locator: Vũ Ngọc, Comm. Math. Phys. 1999 (arXiv math/9810137 for the Bohr–Sommerfeld form); Cushman–Duistermaat 1988; executed demonstration: spherical pendulum lattice shift 0.984 (hbar=0.05) and 0.985 (hbar=0.04), control 0.000
edges.status: SUPPORTED_IN_SCOPE (mathematics); limit check with exact counting function still to be run

edges.statement: Same base loop, different representation: Levi-Civita holonomy on S^2 is the solid angle Ω (Schild's ladder reproduces it to 6e-7); the spin-j phase of the same loop is jΩ; the Bargmann triple phase is the discrete holonomy of the geodesic triangle (geodesic rule).
edges.locator: verify_transport_bridges.py A, C, F; Berry 1984; Simon 1983; Samuel–Bhandari 1988; Mukunda–Simon 1993

edges.statement: Holonomy/transport structure does not select the representation: finite group-valued loop products (program's S3 example), SO(2) Levi-Civita and U(1) Hopf holonomies all live on the same loop structure. Transport alone is not a selection mechanism.
edges.locator: Director D assessment D-TRN-A; baseline note 'formal gauge covariance, cocycles and holonomy do not by themselves identify physical gauge fields'

edges.statement: Continuous Reversibility (connected group acting transitively on pure states) + Tomographic Locality + Subspace Axiom or Existence of an Information Unit force the quantum state space. A finite structure has a finite automorphism group and cannot satisfy Continuous Reversibility directly; a limit construction producing a compact homogeneous pure-state space is an obligation for any finite prephysical candidate.
edges.locator: Hardy 2001; Masanes–Müller 2011; Masanes et al. 2013; obligation argument in D-TRN-C

edges.statement: Oriented triple phase arg Tr(P1 P2 P3): classical point states give {0,1}; real amplitudes give phases in {0, pi}; complex QT gives a continuous phase. Pairwise overlaps do not fix it (program's +X,+Y,+Z example; overlaps witness imaginarity for 4 states but not 3).
edges.locator: verify_transport_bridges.py A, D; Oszmaniec–Brod–Galvão 2024 (NJP) for measurability; Fernandes–Wagner–Novo–Galvão 2024 (arXiv 2403.15066); Renou et al. Nature 2021 and Li et al. 2022 for the network test
edges.status: SUPPORTED_IN_SCOPE (mathematics); CONDITIONAL for application (calibrated preparations, known overlaps, independence)

edges.statement: Sorkin third-order interference I3 vanishes in QT and in all Jordan-algebraic theories; PR-box and pentagon-state correlations require I3 ≠ 0; experiments bound the normalized term near 1e-4.
edges.locator: Sorkin 1994; Sinha et al. 2010; Niestegge arXiv 1303.3986 / 1104.0091
edges.status: external precedent; not a result of this program

edges.statement: The signed-sector proposal names geometry and a continuum as targets. EPS is the template such a route would have to match: primitives -> conformal and projective structures -> Weyl -> metric, each step with its named axiom; the final step requires the absence of a second clock effect (an empirical clock statement).
edges.locator: Ehlers–Pirani–Schild 1972 (reprint GRG 44, 2012); Perlick 1987; Audretsch–Lämmerzahl 1991 for the matter-wave variant

edges.statement: Contextual tables do not select the quantum subset; TO-0 withdrawn as ontology.
edges.locator: Toy packet TU-01; Director C C-ORI-013

edges.statement: Full basis dephasing induces the stochastic transition T_ji=|U_ji|^2 within the toy; this is not a Hamiltonian limit.
edges.locator: Toy packet TU-03; verify_toy_models.py reproduced byte-identically with output path redirected

edges.statement: All central quantum structures are imported; FAR-1 explains none of them.
Fixed positive scaled mass: D_L(mu) = (mu^2/6) log L + finite part - S(mu) + O_mu((log L)^-1); S(mu) is a cross-boundary trace path whose dependency remains an open proof obligation.
edges.locator: Finite Part of Wilson–Dirac Relative Entropy, Theorem 1; collected article §2.2
edges.status: inherited; S(mu) dependency open; not examined this session

obligations_for_any_prephysical_candidat: supply a limit construction whose pure-state space is a compact homogeneous space under a connected group (Continuous Reversibility)
supply tomographic locality (composition rule) and an information unit or subspace structure
exhibit a continuously varying oriented triple phase (imaginarity) with I3 = 0, or else declare which rung of the classical/real/complex/beyond ladder the candidate occupies
for geometry: name the axioms at each EPS step and the clock statement that closes the Weyl-to-metric gap
for dynamics: name the formal update index's relation to a calibrated clock (inherited; open)

retained_outliers.note: retained as data; limiting values are the cited theorems, not these numbers
